topic: Team staffing and technology stack discussion
summary_markdown:
The team discussed the current status of resources, noting that external design support is needed as internal design capacity is lacking. There was a discussion regarding the employment status and role of an individual (Polina). Initially, there was interest in keeping her full-time due to perceived positive contributions, but later consensus suggested transitioning her to a freelance arrangement if her scope of work or technical focus (e.g., Angular) limited her capacity.

Regarding technology, preference was expressed for DotNet and Azure over JavaScript/Angular, with React being noted as more promising than Angular for future development.
decisions: Consider transitioning the individual to a freelance role if full-time work scope is limited
Prioritize DotNet and Azure technologies in development stack planning
Note that React is viewed as more promising than Angular
